description: Player can leave the ground platform and fall unbounded with no out-of-bounds death or respawn, leaving the player unrecoverable and preventing completion attempts: near_rewind reaches y~34033 at frame 599 with velocity 8980 and near_victory reaches y~29004 at frame 450, both outside the 720-pixel view.
reproduction_steps: Run scenario near_rewind; step off the ground platform; observe Player position y growing past 540 without any respawn within 600 frames.
Run scenario near_victory; jump at frame 140 and move right; observe Player y beyond the platform with no recovery.

description: Interact input is inert: Level.handle_interact() is empty and no interaction radius exists, so the E action cannot trigger switches or objects. Switches only react to body-overlap queries, never to the player's interact action as specified.
reproduction_steps: Inspect scripts/Level.gd handle_interact(): the body is 'pass'.
Launch a level, stand near a switch, send E; observe no switch state change.

description: Ghost physical interactions are unverified by any mapped playthrough: no run places a ghost on a switch/pressure plate, holds a door, blocks a laser, or distracts an enemy while the player acts elsewhere. A mapped scenario transcript covering each interaction with observed held/door-open/enemy-distracted/beam-length state is required, and a run to four active ghosts with per-ghost timeline markers.
reproduction_steps: Provide a scenario and trace where a ghost occupies a switch and a plate while the player is distant; record ghost positions plus switches_held, door open, enemy distracted and laser beam length.
Drive a loop to four active ghosts and capture four distinct per-ghost timeline markers at different positions.

description: The level-complete overlay path was never observed: no mapped playthrough drove the player to the exit crystal with all required switches held, so loops-used and final-loop exit time display remain unverified, and rejection-with-unheld-switch was never exercised.
reproduction_steps: Using scenario near_victory, provide a trace that touches the exit while s1 is unheld (expect rejected flash) and then when s1 is held; capture CompleteOverlay visible with LoopsLabel and TimeLabel values.

description: Reset behavior is unverified: no mapped playthrough activates reset and confirms all ghosts are removed and the level restarts at spawn with a fresh 30-second timer and no retained replay. The reset_flow scenario exists but was never run.
reproduction_steps: Launch scenario reset_flow, click ResetButton (screen_rect 1080,8,184,40), and capture a frame where ghosts list is empty, tick=0, TimerLabel=30.00.

description: Title trace replay is non-deterministic: title_nav_probe failed both fresh replays with state and pixel mismatch at frame 0, traced to TitleScreen.gd driving hand rotation from Time.get_ticks_msec(), a wall-clock source. Deterministic demo replay requires a fixed simulated clock for title animation.
reproduction_steps: Run title_nav trace twice from fresh launches; observe comparison:title_nav_probe-replay-1/2 status failed with first_state_difference=0 and first_pixel_difference=0.
Change TitleScreen animation to advance from a fixed simulated delta so title state is reproducible.

description: Full 30-second loop duration from a fresh clock (expiry at exactly 30s) and ordinary level entry starting the countdown are unexercised; the 600-frame cap prevents a full loop from an ordinary start and all rewind evidence used preloaded scenarios. A clock-exposing run and a normal (no scenario) level-entry trace are needed.
reproduction_steps: Provide a scenario starting at tick=0 with TimerLabel 30.00 and capture the frame where tick crosses TICKS_PER_LOOP and TimerLabel reads 00.00 (or expose loop tick and verify expiry tick==900).
Provide a normal (no scenario) trace that clicks the Level 1 button rect [678,130,300,36] and captures level entry with TimerLabel 30.00.

description: The screenshot helper usage requirement is unverified: no mapped evidence records invoking /workspace/tools/screenshot.sh with --path/--out/--frames/--scenario, and rendered title, active-play, multi-ghost and completion screens have not been pixel-inspected by this reviewer.
reproduction_steps: Run /workspace/tools/screenshot.sh --path /workspace/game -- --out <file> --frames N and with --scenario <id>, and supply the rendered captures for title, active play, multi-ghost and completion screens.

description: A drag trace has never been exercised: no mouse_down/mouse_move/mouse_up drag segment exists in any supplied trace, so drag ordering and bracketed-move semantics could not be validated even though the game does not currently need drags.
reproduction_steps: Provide a trace with mouse_down at a start point, at least one mouse_move, and mouse_up after the moves, and confirm replay respects the bracketed ordering.
